# Sanitized production-incident fixtures

These compact JSON fixtures were manually reduced from user-supplied BouncyBot audit bundles and one IB Gateway log. They retain event ordering, contract metadata, price/quantity relationships, status transitions, and source-file SHA-256 fingerprints while excluding account identifiers, local paths, usernames, host details, and full raw logs.

They are test evidence, not market data and not production configuration. The private source bundles are deliberately not included in the repository.
